sources.title: Original user PRD
sources.supported_use: Product/problem, ten tools, real RDS rehearsal, safety boundaries and original source links. Kept byte-for-byte; changes are explicit kit amendments.

sources.title: Canonical HackCulture event page
sources.supported_use: Repeated canonical-page retrieval did not establish the full body. Do not present it as a fully recovered page. Final invitation/on-site rules remain the authority.

sources.title: Official organizer event page, Portuguese path
sources.supported_use: Indexed official English event text supplies provisional agenda, team/repo/disclosure/pitch rules, scoring weights and an explicit statement that Gateway is optional. Direct page fetch was inconsistent; cache may differ from final instructions.

v3_recheck.note: Official organizer text re-retrieved for rubric/real systems/real code/human stop; canonical direct page remains incomplete.

sources.title: Official organizer event page, Spanish path
sources.supported_use: Additional official event description. Localized paths/cached revisions can differ. Do not convert general emphasis on Gateway into an invented mandatory rule.

sources.title: Codex release changelog
sources.supported_use: Current indexed entry names CLI 0.157.0 on 25 September, GPT-6 Sol/Luna support and new session ergonomics. An opened copy was stale; the newer dated indexed entry and tagged source govern the researched baseline.

sources.title: Codex 0.157 configuration schema
sources.supported_use: Agents schema confirms enabled, max_concurrent_threads_per_session, default_subagent_model and default_subagent_reasoning_effort. max_depth is backend-specific; max_spawn_depth is not defined. Installed parsing still needs T01.

v3_recheck.note: rust-v0.157.0 agent-schema section re-read; whole installed config not executed.

sources.title: Codex custom subagents
sources.supported_use: Standalone role files require name, description and developer_instructions. Role model/effort can override spawn values; child-count limit excludes the primary. Older model examples on the page do not supersede current model releases.

v3_recheck.note: Current subagent docs re-read for role precedence, permissions and child count.

sources.title: Codex repository instructions
sources.supported_use: Repository instruction routing/scoping reference inherited from the first audit. V2 uses a small router; effective loaded instructions are checked in the actual harness.

sources.title: Codex skills
sources.supported_use: Repository .agents/skills discovery and SKILL.md guidance. Four narrow routers are the kit design, not a claim more skills improve performance.

sources.title: Goals in Codex
sources.supported_use: Documented persistent thread Goal and interactive management commands. Thread scope/budget/pause behavior means the repository ledger remains necessary.

sources.title: Rethinking skills and prompts for Astra
sources.supported_use: 11 September article favors small task-relevant skill descriptions, progressive disclosure and explicit completion instead of excessive universal instructions. Detailed product contracts remain on-demand.

sources.title: Codex hooks
sources.supported_use: Lifecycle configuration requires review/trust and supported command behavior. Hooks are not a security boundary. This kit ships no active hook that calls nonexistent application scripts.

sources.title: Codex worktrees
sources.supported_use: Reference for separate checkouts. T01 verifies native feature availability; ordinary Git worktrees and explicit cwd verification provide the planned fallback.

sources.title: OpenAI model catalog
sources.supported_use: Current catalog names Astra for difficult reasoning/coding, Sol for balanced work and Luna for focused efficiency. The exact task assignments are our recommendation, not a comparative benchmark.

sources.title: GPT-6 Astra model
sources.supported_use: Current model identity and effort options verified through indexed official content after a direct-fetch error. Availability in this operator account is not established.

sources.title: GPT-6 Sol model
sources.supported_use: Sol supports reasoning/tool work via Responses; Chat Completions functions require none. This is an API constraint, not a Codex setting or Gateway entitlement.

v3_recheck.note: GPT-6 Sol model page re-retrieved from official indexed content; actual account/transport probe remains required.

sources.title: GPT-6 Luna model
sources.supported_use: Focused-task model and current tool/effort constraints. Optional clerical assignment only; not an additional product dependency.

sources.title: OpenAI API changelog
sources.supported_use: 22 September entry verifies Sol/Luna release. New API/harness features were considered, but the event product remains TrueForge rather than being replaced by a managed coding harness.

sources.title: OpenAI deployment checklist
sources.supported_use: Critical current constraints: Astra tools require Responses; Sol/Luna Chat Completions tools require none; unsupported sampling/log-probability parameters must be removed. Representative project probes precede migration.

sources.title: OpenAI code-generation guidance
sources.supported_use: Current general-purpose coding guidance supports Astra for complex end-to-end work. Does not prove every task needs the highest effort or every account has access.

sources.title: TrueForge package metadata at PRD commit
sources.supported_use: Version 0.2.1 and Node >=22.14 source metadata verified. Package installation/integrity and all runtime integrations remain untested in this kit.

sources.title: TrueForge README at PRD commit
sources.supported_use: Harness/tool/sandbox/UI separation and private local-mode warning. Preserve the real runtime, not a separate invented dashboard.

sources.title: TrueForge model configuration at PRD commit
sources.supported_use: Custom endpoints and stored model resources; automatic per-turn model selection is described as planned. Do not advertise implicit runtime model routing.

sources.title: TrueForge saved-agent and approval reference
sources.supported_use: Literal approval configuration is part of the original verified design. Final effective config and Code Mode gating must be observed in the installed package.

sources.title: TrueForge sandbox reference
sources.supported_use: Daytona setup and sandbox/snapshot permissions. Provider quota/scopes and a real execution ID are T20 checks; do not assume the local model process is Daytona.

sources.title: TrueForge Code Mode reference
sources.supported_use: Generated code calls tools through the harness bridge. Do not copy Python-client return wrappers into Code Mode without observing its actual shape.

v3_recheck.note: Pinned Code Mode source re-read: programmatic MCP bridge, compact results and preserved approval checks.

sources.title: TrueForge MCP setup reference
sources.supported_use: Private connector setup reference. Its discovery/schema and streamable transport still need a live compatibility probe.

sources.title: TrueForge model adapter implementation
sources.supported_use: The openai adapter calls client.responses; custom/truefoundry route to an OpenAI-compatible model adapter. Provider base URL/schema details must match the installed build and authorized Gateway.

sources.title: Gateway quickstart
sources.supported_use: Copy real Playground base URL, key scope and model ID. Do not append guessed API prefixes or confuse saved TrueForge resource names with upstream provider IDs.

sources.title: Gateway Chat Completions
sources.supported_use: Gateway provider-account/model identifiers and chat request shape. Compatible chat availability alone does not establish Responses or reasoning-tool support for a model.

sources.title: OpenAI latest-model migration guidance
sources.supported_use: Endpoint/effort migration and unsupported request fields. Use with the pinned adapter and actual Gateway test, not model-string replacement alone.

sources.title: Gateway request logging
sources.supported_use: Review request/response logging and trace exposure; collect only actual permitted metadata. Logging is not permission to transmit DB rows or secrets.

sources.title: September 23 Gateway catalog announcement
sources.supported_use: Publisher reports Sol/Luna catalog availability. This does not prove team access, the selected API route or the behavior of a cached/older provider configuration.

sources.title: Python MCP v2.2.0 package source
sources.supported_use: Tag and Python requirement verified. A cached PyPI latest page showed an older snapshot, so fresh registry resolution/install must not be claimed complete.

sources.title: MCP Python v2 migration guide
sources.supported_use: Major API/lifecycle/transport/result changes and telemetry behavior need deliberate handling. Wire compatibility is tested against the actual TrueForge client, not inferred from matching SDK majors.

sources.title: pglast 8.4 metadata
sources.supported_use: Version-specific metadata and GPL-3.0-or-later inventory note. No source upgrade or distribution-license decision is made by this kit.

sources.title: pglast maintainer version mapping
sources.supported_use: The inherited pairing is v8/PostgreSQL18 and v7/PostgreSQL17. Revalidate the exact available parser distribution and actual engine at T01.

sources.title: AWS RDS snapshot restore
sources.supported_use: New instance restore, lazy loading and current storage restrictions. Actual source/clone identity, storage, network and encryption are independently checked before readiness.

v3_recheck.note: AWS restore guidance rechecked; independent instance and storage lazy loading remain relevant.

sources.title: AWS RDS snapshot creation
sources.supported_use: Snapshot is an instance-level AWS operation, not a single-database export. Observe the real asynchronous job and provenance.

sources.title: RDS PostgreSQL SSL
sources.supported_use: Encryption and endpoint/CA verification must be treated separately. Negative CA/hostname tests are our deployment acceptance requirement.

sources.title: EC2 IAM roles
sources.supported_use: Instance-role runtime credentials rather than static AWS secrets. Account-specific policies and grants remain operator-authorized implementation work.

sources.title: Boto3 snapshot restore API
sources.supported_use: Target request fields must be verified against the installed compatible boto3/botocore pair. Do not assume IAM/KMS/engine/class choices are universally valid.

sources.title: PostgreSQL explicit locking
sources.supported_use: Locks motivate the conservative static-source recheck/write design. That design is not a claim of an online migration strategy for live production traffic.

v3_recheck.note: PostgreSQL 18 lock documentation re-read to support conservative locked source recheck.

sources.title: PostgreSQL 18 ALTER TABLE
sources.supported_use: Constraint/locking reference. Exact allowed subcommands and nested-expression policy are defined by this product, not delegated to the model.

sources.title: Psycopg transactions
sources.supported_use: Explicit transaction behavior reference. The retrieved docs advertised a development version; no development version is asserted as the installed stable release.

sources.title: Psycopg multiple statements
sources.supported_use: Exact-script execution needs actual multi-result/error/rollback tests. Do not assume a later-statement error is handled because the first result succeeded.

sources.title: RDS recovery reference
sources.supported_use: A recovery restore is not an automatic SQL undo. Retention and unknown-outcome rules remain explicit; no live recovery drill was performed by this kit.

sources.title: GPT-5.6 Sol model reference
sources.supported_use: Exact model family/ID and tool interfaces support the requested Sol alternative. API prices are not converted into a promised Codex allowance saving; account access/effective High still require T01.

sources.title: ChatGPT Work and Codex allowance
sources.supported_use: Astra can consume Work/Codex allowance faster; consumption depends on workload/settings and sign-in/billing route. Supports bounded expert use, not a universal savings percentage.

sources.title: PostgreSQL 18 transaction isolation
sources.supported_use: Supports consistent baseline captures and the distinct locked READ COMMITTED source apply procedure. V3 coverage and offline-verifier logic are our design, not a PostgreSQL feature claim.

sources.title: Atlas migration tests
sources.supported_use: Documents executing migrations and assertions on a development database. Establishes that migration testing already exists; not an exhaustive competitive comparison.

sources.title: Flyway dry-run tutorial
sources.supported_use: Official tutorial updated 24 September 2026 describes read-only assessment and generated SQL for review. Distinguish SQL preview from Preflight's proposed executed clone evidence without claiming all other Flyway capabilities absent.

sources.title: OpenAI reasoning guidance
sources.supported_use: Reasoning/effort and service choices have model-specific support. V3 defaults to High and avoids automatic premium escalation; test actual provider requests.

sources.title: PostgreSQL 18 row security
sources.supported_use: Role-dependent row visibility reinforces the existing fail-closed unsupported-RLS policy. No new claim of general RLS-safe migration support.
